description:
#Explore Torrey Pines & Discover Yoga Bliss on The Beach

Embark on a deeply restorative hiking journey into the beauty and powerful energy of Torrey Pines with tranquil yoga on the beach. 

Release worldly stress, gain peace of mind and connect with the magic of the Pacific Ocean.
					
You'll work with a professional Yoga Teacher & Guide as you journey mindfully down a serene trail with sweeping views of the Ocean.  Unplug, and learn about the land as you tune in to the peace found only in nature.  

Upon reaching the pristine beach, you'll enjoy a blissful yoga, breath work and meditation session in sand.

**Ready to Book? Pick your desired date & time from the calendar and reserve your spot today!**

##Session Includes:
- 3hr Custom, Private Tour with an Experienced Teacher
- Perfect Balance of Yoga & Hiking
- Restorative Hatha Yoga on the beach!
- Soul-Charging Breath-Work
- Deep Guided Meditation
- Complimentary Yoga Mat/Blanket Rentals

##Hike Length & Difficulty
- 4 Mile Hike
- Gentle, Beautiful Trail
- All Levels Welcome

##What to Bring
- Water Bottle
- Comfy Clothes
- Good Shoes

##About Your Hosts
Vita Pura Yoga has grown from a humble living room yoga studio to a top yoga retreat and wellness company (TripAdvisor, 2022/23). Their unique combination of traditional yoga science with soulful hiking has helped thousands of students blossom and grow. Now home to a team teachers, healers and guides, they deliver specular results to students every day. If you're looking for a special spiritual experience in San Diego, you've found it.

##How It Works
We make this experience as easy as possible.  Just meet your teacher at the trailhead. Your teacher will have yoga mats ready to lend for the adventure.

##Is This Good For Groups?
This is perfect for groups of all sizes, from solo travelers to groups of 15+.  Enjoy a custom experience designed to meet your groups level, goals and needs with expert attention from our amazing teachers.

##Do I Need Past Yoga or Hiking Experience?
All ages and levels are welcome, no experience required - just an open mind and desire to grow. Your teacher will customize the session based on your unique needs and level.

##What Kind of Yoga Is This?
We teach authentic, traditional Hatha yoga science.  The practice is true to its holistic Eastern roots as apposed to Western "fitness yoga".  You'll learn to move energy within the body through invigorating Pranayama (Breath Work) alongside restorative asana postures and deep meditation.  In doing so, you'll be able to release stress, trauma and old wounds, creating space for healing.

##What Do Our Clients Say?
- "Our first experience with yoga hiking! I am an average yogi, my husband has no experience with yoga at all, and neither of us are super experienced hikers. **I am so glad I booked this, it was the highlight of our trip!**"
-Chrissy

- "**I had a truly transformational and peaceful experience**...The hike was beautiful. My guide led me to some amazing Breath-Work where I embodied a sense of inner peace that I have a never experienced."
-Sherri

- "We had the best time on our hike with Nichole! She was so easy to connect with and taught us a ton. Our yoga experience was incredible - the views were 10/10 as well as our session. **Can’t recommend this experience enough!!**"
-Spencer

- "The overall experience was amazing on all fronts. Reservation process was simple and communication was excellent. Reminders and meeting point GPS was provided prior to scheduled event...**Hike was gorgeous and yoga was perfect.** This yoga and hiking event was the focal point of our trip for my wife's 50th birthday."
-Charlie

- "Where do I start? **I booked this tour with some girlfriends and we had an amazing experience.** Our instructor’s name was Minyan...He provided us with information about the city, the park, the wildlife, the plants and gave us recommendations to check out. And to top it all off, he was an excellent yoga instructor. He provided modifications and a better understanding of yoga."
-Denisse

**Don't miss this once in a lifetime experience. Create a memory that won't just leave you charged, it'll leave you transformed.**
